rollback_or_rollforward: Reversible: downgrade drops the tenant-isolation RLS policies (and disables FORCE/RLS) on the northstar_governance.governance_decision and governance_exception tables, then drops both tables and the northstar_governance schema (CASCADE); on a shared environment restore from the pre-migration backup instead. The schema holds only immutable governance decision records and time-bounded control-exception metadata, so a rollback affects no other module's data.

prechecks: database is a supported PostgreSQL version
postchecks: northstar_governance schema with the governance_decision and governance_exception tables exists
row-level security is enabled and forced on every tenant-scoped governance table with a tenant-isolation policy keyed to the northstar.tenant_id GUC
